factValues.name: gr:fact-1d061e36f6596992_fv
factValues.value: The company is a private company limited by shares and registered in England and Wales. It was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-02cfcac8f6134cdc_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit in accordance with section 476 of the Companies Act 2006.

factValues.name: gr:fact-8b704ae7efb32483_fv
factValues.value: The Director acknowledges their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-47d80d801508cd3c_fv
factValues.value: These accounts have been prepared in accordance with the micro-entity provisions and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.
